title: Building a real-time AI tutor for 5-year-olds
summary: The team built an AI tutor for children ages 4-9 that teaches reading, math, and ESL. The core technical challenge was achieving real-time UX steering and complex decision-making at conversation speed, which required replacing the standard tool-use loop with a custom streaming tutor harness.
problem_solved: Enabling AI tutors to effectively teach young children in real-time while making complex pedagogical decisions at conversation speed.
why_valuable: Young children require instant, adaptive responses that standard AI architectures cannot provide, making this a technically demanding problem with significant educational impact.
